column4: dialect-gated: cleat#2237's live-interleaving race test for handleIngestWebhook has postgres, mysql and mssql_rcsi_on subtests; mssql_rcsi_on forces READ_COMMITTED_SNAPSHOT on in a private database (webhookingestPrivateRCSIDatabase), built only when CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL is set. ci.yml's test-go/plugins job provides only PostgreSQL (CLEAT_TEST_DB), so this subtest skips there. The mysql subtest needs no line: it loops over testutil.NewPluginTestBackends and, with CLEAT_TEST_MYSQL unset, finds no MySQL backend and returns without calling t.Skip -- a trivial PASS, not a skip event. Measured by name: go test ./plugins/webhookingest/... -run TestAnIngestRacingAnOpenDeleteTransactionIsBlocked -count=1 -json | grep '"Action":"skip"' with CLEAT_TEST_MYSQL and CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL unset reports exactly the mssql_rcsi_on skip and nothing for mysql.
